text:
sara: Heads-up — final launch sync for the "Launch Spinup" post. Need: final changelog bullets, docs links, benchmark blurb, and webinar CTA by EOD tomorrow. Can eng confirm rollout timing? @alex @jamal

alex: We can do next-week canary. Target canary start 2026-04-01 09:00 PT. Is that ok for marketing? :calendar:

jamal: That works. Can we lock model fallback in place before canary? I can push policy by Friday.

priya: Docs PR is open: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/452 — still needs a short 'what's new' top paragraph and the embed links. I'll add screenshots after code freeze.

sara: Perfect. Marketing needs the docs link for the announcement and the canonical changelog lines (3 bullets max). Can someone paste the final bullets here? :pray:

alex: Changelog bullets:
- Reduced token latency by 18% for short queries via kernel routing updates
- Added automatic prefix caching for chat sessions, reducing duplicate compute
- New dedicated deployment policy: regional fallback + canary flag

jamal: Minor wording tweak: change "automatic prefix caching" -> "adaptive prefix/KV caching". Also add a bullet about quantization profile recommendation later this week.

sara: Updated copy: "Reduced token latency by 18% for short queries; adaptive prefix/KV caching to cut repeat compute; regional fallback + canary rollout policy for Dedicated." Good?

marta: Webinar slot confirmed for 2026-04-02 11:00 PT. Landing page and registration go live once we have the announcement link. Need hero quote from Eng/PM.

priya: I can add an inline code snippet for the quickstart in docs. Sample:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-small","prompt":"Summarize..."}'
```

sara: Can Eng/PM provide a 1-sentence quote for the hero and a short benchmark line we can use on the landing page? Preferably < 140 chars.

alex: Quote: "Serving predictably at scale lets teams focus on product, not plumbing." Benchmark: "18% lower token latency on short queries (internal perf suite)."

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2026-04-01T09:00:00Z on cluster-west-2. Rollout policy: canary=10%, fallback=auto.

jamal: We'll post the final changelog PR in the next hour: https://github.com/redwood/core/pull/987 — comments welcome.

sara: Amazing — I'll draft the launch post and webinar page now. Will ping for approvals once copy is in place. Thanks all :tada:

alex: Reviewing PR now. Drop anything urgent here.

priya: I'll queue the docs refresh immediately after the PR merges.

sara: Closing loop: marketing will send final copy by 2026-03-25 17:00 PT. If eng needs to shift canary, flag here. :rocket:
